cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a contemporary private overnight ferry cabin with a round window — she sits back after reaching for a folded blank timetable; a starship data archive — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a quiet modern seaside guesthouse bedroom with pale blue walls — she laughs softly at the distant cry of a gull while sitting up from a deep cushioned window seat; a bright bathroom with a mirror — standing; inside a general's command tent — sitting on the ground; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — lying on her front
